jobs.title: Senior Process Automation Engineer (DSP) (f/m/d), 100%
jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

For this large-scale CAPEX investment project, we are seeking an experienced Senior Process Automation Engineer (f/m/d) with a focus on downstream processing automation .

Your tasks:

You are a technical expert (SME) for process automation (DSP) within a major CAPEX project (> CHF 100 million)

Design, develop, and implement automation solutions (Level 0–2.5) for downstream unit operations:

Chromatography

Filtration (UF/DF, TFF)

Purification processes

Translate process requirements into automation concepts, batch logic and control strategies

Review and optimize automation designs and system architectures in collaboration with external partners

Integrate systems into the overall automation landscape (DCS, PLC, MES, Historian)

Ensure compliance with GMP, GAMP5, data integrity and validation requirements

Coordinate and lead external engineering firms, system integrators and contractors

Collaborate closely with Engineering, MSAT, IT/OT, and Quality

Support the project from concept phase through commissioning, qualification, and handover

Contribute to standardization and development of automation concepts for the new site

Ensure delivery in terms of quality, budget, and timeline

Your profile:

Degree in automation, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field

At least 8–10 years of experience in automation within pharmaceutical or biotech environments

Strong expertise in:

Downstream process automation (chromatography, filtration, purification)

DCS system (Siemens PCS7, PCSneo), PLC (e.g. Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA (WinCC) and batch control

Experience with MES, historian and data/PAT integration

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

For this strategic CAPEX program, we are seeking an experienced Senior Building Automation Engineer (SME BMS) to shape and deliver state-of-the-art facility automation systems in a GMP-regulated environment .

Your tasks:

Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Building Automation / BMS within a major CAPEX project (> CHF 100M)

Lead the design, specification and implementation of building automation systems, including:

HVAC and utility controls(e.g. cooling system and chiller, compressed air)

Fire protection and Evacuation System

Access Control & Attendance Time Recording

Gas Detection System

CCTV & Intrusion detection

Define and review automation concepts, system architectures and interfaces (e.g. BMS ↔ PCS / PLC / SCADA / IT systems)

Ensure seamless integration of BMS into the overall plant automation landscape

Develop and review key lifecycle documents:

URS / FS / DS

Automation and data integrity concepts

Commissioning and qualification strategies

Ensure compliance with GMP, GAMP5, Annex 1/11, 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity requirements

Lead and coordinate external engineering companies, system integrators and vendors

Oversee commissioning, qualification (CQV) and validation activities

Collaborate closely with Engineering, Operations, IT/OT, CSV and Quality functions

Support standardization and development of BMS concepts for the new site

Drive troubleshooting, performance optimization and digitalization initiatives

Ensure adherence to project timelines, quality and budget targets

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur principal de la construction Sisslerfeld (f/m/j), 100 %

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced Construction Management Coordinator / Construction Manager (f/m/d), 100% on the client side, who will be responsible for the professional management of the construction site, the coordination of external CM teams, and the assurance of quality, safety, and efficiency in demanding construction projects.

Your tasks:

Main point of contact and advisor to the program team for all CM-related matters

Support for sub‑project managers and the program manager in CM processes

Ensuring execution quality, schedule adherence, cost targets, and occupational safety

Further development of CM processes, workflows, and interfaces

Acting in the role of Client‑Side Construction Manager together with the construction project lead

Authority to issue instructions to the external CM team on site

Forwarding of defects, deviations, or improvement proposals

Intervention in safety‑critical situations and stopping work when necessary

Regular site inspections to verify safety, order, and cleanliness

Conducting or supporting risk analyses during ongoing operations

Monitoring compliance with HSE requirements and safety concepts

Interface between projects, operations, facility management, and other initiatives

Participation in construction, safety, and ad‑hoc meetings

Ensuring transparent and proactive communication

Review of execution plans, schedules, method statements, and safety documentation

Monitoring execution according to specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements (including GMP/GDP where relevant)

Support during inspections, handovers, site checks, and defect management

Documentation of site diary, deviations, defects, and construction progress

Support with change orders, claims, and evaluation of external services

Coordination of logistics, closures, access control, and site infrastructure

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer (f/m/d) , 100% to support our global capital projects and play a key role in the standardization and further development of C&Q processes across our international network. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and management of C&Q activities – from concept to handover – and will contribute your expertise to a wide range of projects worldwide.

Your tasks:

Leadership of C&Q activities within multidisciplinary large capital projects

Coordination and management of C&Q‑related deviations and changes within defined timelines and in compliance with required quality standards

Responsibility for budget, schedule, prioritization, resources, and the quality of C&Q execution

Analysis of options, planning of execution strategies, and development of detailed C&Q schedules

Preparation of tender documents, support in procurement processes, and cost estimation

Ensuring a smooth handover to Operations and Quality

Risk management, including the derivation of proactive measures in case of deviations

Management and onboarding of the C&Q team, including external partners

Responsibility for training C&Q teams and ensuring adherence to internal standards

Clear, structured, and audience‑appropriate communication with all stakeholders

Close collaboration with global sites to harmonize C&Q standards and digital processes

Support in supplier evaluation and coaching of local SMEs

Active promotion of lean and agile methods within engineering and C&Q contexts

Further development of digital tools (e.g., Veeva), interfaces, and templates

Technical review activities in CAPEX projects

Participation in or leadership of international teams in GMP engineering, C&Q, and global initiatives

Your profile:

Completed degree in engineering, natural sciences, or a related field

At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced Commissioning Manager (f/m/d), 100% to lead and coordinate the commissioning phase (C&Q) of major pharmaceutical CAPEX projects on the client side. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, managing, and ensuring the quality of all commissioning activities from the concept phase through final handover, ensuring that all work is carried out in a GMP‑compliant, safe, and efficient manner.

Your tasks:

Development, structuring, and further enhancement of commissioning concepts, strategies, and execution models (including lean‑based workflows)

Management of the complete commissioning process (pre‑commissioning, cold/hot commissioning, testing, start‑up)

Leadership and coordination of internal and external commissioning teams

Planning and monitoring of schedules, costs, quality, and risks

Close collaboration with the program’s Qualification Manager

Interdisciplinary coordination with Engineering, Automation, Quality, Operations, HSE, suppliers, and construction management

Ensuring a structured flow of information among all project stakeholders

Ensuring all safety‑related requirements during commissioning (HSE, HAZOP, permits, work authorizations)

Conducting or supporting risk analyses and hazard assessments in line with current industry role expectations (e.g., hazard assessments & HSE implementation as core commissioning tasks)

Proactive enforcement of safety standards, including intervention in critical situations

Ensuring GMP/GDP and GAMP compliance of commissioning activities, considering an integrated commissioning and qualification approach

Development, review, and approval of test plans, logs, checklists, and technical documents

Support of qualification activities (IQ/OQ/PQ)

Contribution to the development and standardization of internal company guidelines for commissioning

Evaluation of new tools, methods, and processes to improve efficiency, quality, and safety

Application of lean principles to optimize workflows and resource utilization

Your profile:

Degree in engineering (process engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, pharmaceutical engineering, or similar)

Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation. • Cosa offriamo - Un'opportunità di lavoro stimolante e impegnativa in un ambiente dinamico e in rapida crescita - La possibilità di influire in modo duraturo sull'azienda e sulla regione attraverso la tua posizione # Contatto Se sei interessato alla posizione, ti invitiamo a inviare la tua candidatura completa attraverso il nostro portale di candidatura. Scopri di più sul gruppo Bachem e lasciati ispirare dal nostro ambiente di lavoro stimolante! Nota: le candidature delle agenzie di personale non saranno prese in considerazione. descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Per far progredire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati.
• Cerchiamo una personalità dedicata come Process Expert Technical Operations (MSAT) - API Production Sisslerfeld 100% (m/w/d) Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del nostro nuovo impianto di processo a valle regolamentato Greenfield GMP per la produzione API a Sisslerfeld, si lavora all'interfaccia tra produzione, qualità, ingegneria e project management, nonché altre funzioni del sito e processi e strutture attivamente avanzati. --- Mansioni - Responsabilità speciale per la definizione dei requisiti di processo per le operazioni delle unità a valle nei concetti di pulizia e contenimento, Strategie di controllo delle contaminazioni (CCS) e analisi di rischio rilevanti per GMP - Sostegno alle valutazioni di scala e alle valutazioni di processo nell'ambito dello sviluppo di impianti e processi - Monitoraggio della messa in servizio di nuovi impianti e del supporto nell'attuazione e nella realizzazione dei processi produttivi - Costruzione e documentazione dei processi aziendali TechOps nel corso dello sviluppo della posizione - Attuazione delle attrezzature di trasferimento tecnologico e creazione e realizzazione di piani di trasferimento - Supporto tecnico per la produzione in questioni di processo e per l'analisi e il trattamento delle deviazioni - stretta collaborazione con Manufacturing, TechOps, Engineering, QA e Project Management - Supporto per ispezioni governative e audit dei clienti durante la configurazione e l'avvio ---
• Requisiti - Studio completo di chimica, chimica farmaceutica, biotecnologia o disciplina tecnica o scientifica comparabile, idealmente con dottorato - Esperienza pluriennale nell'elaborazione a valle o a monte delle API in un ambiente regolamentato da GMP - conoscenza della cromatografia preparatoria; Esperienza con essiccazione congelata e essiccazione spray - Buona conoscenza della produzione chimica, ingegneria dei processi, pianificazione degli impianti e requisiti normativi (ad esempio ICH Q7, FDA, EMA) - Esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di Tech Transfers - Funzionamento strutturato e orientato alla soluzione e capacità di sviluppare soluzioni pragmatiche anche in situazioni complesse o non chiare - Personalità orientata al team con comunicazione chiara e aperta e la capacità di riunire diverse interfacce - Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura --- Cosa? - Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con lo sviluppo interno e ulteriori opportunità di formazione - Design flessibile del tempo di lavoro con possibilità per l'ufficio di casa e l'opzione per coprire giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi con carico di lavoro ridotto - KITA interna al Bachem Campus Bubendorf
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. We are looking for a dedicated personality as a Process Expert Technical Operations (MSAT) - API Production Sisslerfeld 100% (m/w/d) As part of the development of our new Greenfield GMP-regulated downstream process plant for API production in Sisslerfeld, you work at the interface between production, quality, engineering and project management as well as other site functions and actively advance processes and structures. --- Mansioni - Special responsibility for defining process requirements for downstream unit operations in cleaning and containment concepts, Contamination Control Strategies (CCS) and GMP-relevant risk analyses - Support for scale-up evaluations and process evaluations as part of plant and process development - Monitoring the commissioning of new plants and support in the implementation and establishment of production processes - Construction and documentation of TechOps business processes in the course of location development - Implementation of tech transfer equipment and creation and implementation of transfer plans - Technical support for production in process questions and for analysis and processing of deviations - Close cooperation with Manufacturing, TechOps, Engineering, QA and Project Management - Support for government inspections and customer audits during setup and start-up ---
• Requisiti - Complete study of chemistry, pharmaceutical chemistry, biotechnology or a comparable technical or scientific discipline, ideally with doctorate - Multiannual experience in large scale downstream or upstream processing of APIs in a GMP-regulated environment - knowledge of preparative chromatography; Experience with freeze drying and spray drying - Good knowledge of chemical production, process engineering, plant planning and regulatory requirements (e.g. ICH Q7, FDA, EMA) - Experience in the planning and implementation of Tech Transfers - Structured and solution-oriented operation and the ability to develop pragmatic solutions even in complex or unclear situations - Team-oriented personality with clear, open communication and the ability to bring different interfaces together - Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing ---
• Cosa offriamo - A dynamic and growing working environment with internal development and further training opportunities - Flexible work time design with possibility for home office and option to cover additional holiday days with reduced workload - Internal KITA at Bachem Campus Bubendorf

jobs.description:
To support our continued organic growth and the development of a major Greenfield project , we are seeking highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team at the site level, we are looking for a dedicated Site HSE Manager (f/m/d), 100 - Sisslerfeld . In this key role, you will ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment across all our site operations.

Your tasks:

Lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of all HSE concepts and standards.

Act as the main responsible person for HSE internally and externally.

Develop and execute hazard and risk assessments (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP).

Establish occupational health, safety, and industrial hygiene programs; coordinate and document hygiene measurements.

Define HSE requirements for site projects and ensure alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE, and local HSE teams.

Cooperate with fire brigade, emergency services, and external authorities on emergency management.

Create, review, and approve HSE-related procedures and documentation (SOPs, VORs, policies).

Deliver HSE training and promote behavior‑based safety on site.

Support sustainability initiatives and monitor regulatory developments.

Build and develop a strong HSE organization and act as a role model in change management.

Your 
• Profile:

Degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field

Several years of solid HSE experience

Deep understanding of chemical production processes and safety controls

Strong digital and IT competence

Experience applying modern HSE methodologies and staying up‑to‑date with evolving regulations

Experience in ensuring alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE and internal site HSE teams

Ability to train, coach and educate employees on HSE regulations and safety culture

Strong project‑management skills to support large‑scale site or construction projects

Leadership mindset, able to lead according to corporate leadership principles and foster entrepreneurial thinking

Strong communication & stakeholder management

Experience in Swiss/EU regulatory frameworks (optional but valuable)

Fluent in German and English

Our offer:

A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Good transportation access & parking

Good work environment grounded in innovation and purpose and with a strong focus on Safety first culture.

Employee events and employee participation.

jobs.title: Technical Author Peptide Manufacturing (w/m/d), 100%
jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung des bestehenden Teams in unserer Wirkstoffproduktion suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierte/n Technical Author Peptide Manufacturing (w/m/d), 100%.

Sie sind verantwortlich für das Schreiben produktionsrelevanter GMP-Dokumente und sind in dieser Rolle auf eine Produktionseinheit (Manufacturing Cluster) spezialisiert.

Ihre Aufgaben

Verfassen, Aktualisieren und Optimieren von Herstellvorschriften (MBPRs), SOPs, Logbüchern und Risikoanalysen (FMEAs) für den Bereich Peptide Manufacturing.

Sicherstellung einer formalen und inhaltlichen Dokumentqualität nach GMP sowie internen Richtlinien.

Umsetzung von Änderungen an Master Batch Records (MBRs) im MES (PAS-X) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Produzenten.

Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung von Dokumentvorlagen und Standards zur Effizienzsteigerung in der Dokumentenerstellung.

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem zugewiesenen Peptide-Manufacturing-Cluster und Aufbau eines fundierten Verständnisses für Herstellprozesse, Anlagen und Abläufe.

Aktive Teilnahme an Prozessabstimmungen, Shopfloor-Begehungen sowie Austausch mit Operators, Production Leaders und Chemikern zur Sicherstellung einer präzisen und praxisnahen Dokumentation.

Einhaltung aller relevanten GMP-, HSE- und Compliance-
• Anforderungen.

Sicherstellung der korrekten Implementierung der 
• Anforderungen in Herstellvorschriften, SOPs und Risikoanalysen.

Unterstützung bei internen und externen Audits durch Bereitstellung der relevanten Dokumente und Auskünfte.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (f/m/d), 100%
jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated Platform Engineer (f/m/d), 100%.

We are strengthening our digital capabilities by establishing an Azure-based Internal Developer Platform. In this hands-on role, you will work on platform infrastructure components, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code to enable standardized application delivery and self-service capabilities. You will work closely with platform users across the organization to continuously improve the developer’s experience.

Your tasks:

Operate and continuously evolve the Internal Developer Platform based on Azure, GitHub, and Infrastructure as Code.

Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable developers with automated workflows by building and maintaining containerized workloads.

Provide a consistent end-to-end developer experience by standardizing tooling from local IDEs to CI/CD pipelines and runtime environments.

Collaborate closely with the Platform Owner to translate platform roadmap and requirements into technical solutions.

Improve developer workflows by simplifying processes, reducing manual effort, and promoting standardized approaches.

Ensure platform reliability and security via monitoring, observability, and policy-driven governance.

Enable citizen developers to adopt the platform by providing technical guidance, best practices, and troubleshooting support.

Create documentation, guidelines, and onboarding materials to support sustainable platform adoption.

Your profile:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a specialized field related to DevOps development or engineering.

Proficiency in DevOps automation (Terraform, GitHub Actions) and scripting (PowerShell, Python).

Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Azure Container Apps) and cloud-native architectures.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, preferably in enterprise-scale cloud environments

A collaborative mindset — You work closely with developers, understand their needs, proactively translate requirements into user stories and propose technical solutions.

Strong time management skills — You’re able to self-organize, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

Experience working in agile environments, with the ability to apply agile principles and mindset to daily work — You’re comfortable delivering iteratively and maintaining consistent progress in a dynamic environment.

A cloud certification (e.g., Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent) is considered a strong advantage.

jobs.description: Quality Engineering (QE) als technischer Bereich der Qualitätssicherung (QA/RA) stellt die GMP-Compliance von Produktions‑, Analyse‑ und Infrastruktursystemen sicher – und leistet damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Innovations‑ und Wachstumskraft der Bachem Gruppe. Zur Verstärkung unseres leistungsstarken Teams am Standort Bubendorf suchen wir per sofort eine engagierte und fachlich versierte Persönlichkeit als Specialist QA Engineering (w/m/d) . Ihre Aufgaben Als Mitarbeiter/in im QA Engineering übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle im Life‑Cycle‑Management unserer GMP‑relevanten Anlagen und Systeme: Sicherstellung des GMP‑konformen Anlagenbetriebs über den gesamten Lebenszyklus inkl. Requalifizierung, Instandhaltung, Change Control und Abweichungsmanagement Mitarbeit an Qualifizierungs‑ und Validierungsprojekten (Equipment, Infrastruktur, Prozesse) sowie fachliche Bewertung aus QA‑Sicht Erstellung, Prüfung und Freigabe von GMP‑relevanten Dokumenten (z. B. URS, Qualifizierungspakete, SOPs, Logbücher) Aktives Reporting und fachliche Beratung von Stakeholdern in technischen und qualitätsrelevanten Fragestellungen Unterstützung bei Behördeninspektionen, Kundenaudits sowie Koordination termingerechter Tätigkeiten wie PQR‑Erstellung oder Batch-Dokument‑Review Übernahme kleinerer Projekte im Bereich QE und Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung bereichsübergreifender Qualitätsprozesse Ihr Profil Sie arbeiten präzise, vorausschauend und verantwortungsbewusst – und bringen die Fähigkeiten mit, um in einem anspruchsvollen GMP‑Umfeld erfolgreich zu sein: Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium (BSc in Chemie, Pharmazie, Verfahrenstechnik oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung) oder gleichwertige Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger QS‑Erfahrung Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im GMP‑regulierten Umfeld, idealerweise im Bereich Qualifizierung/Validierung oder technischen QA‑Prozessen Fundierte GMP‑Kenntnisse der Schweiz und EU sowie sicheres Erstellen und Bewerten von GMP‑relevanten Dokumenten Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) in Wort und Schrift Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, ERP‑/MES‑/QM‑Systemen sowie digitalen Kommunikations‑ und Planungstools Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Lösungsorientierung, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit internen wie externen Stakeholdern Unser Angebot Wir bieten dir eine spannende Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und stark   wachsenden Unternehmen, sowie zukunftssichere Arbeitsplätze mit grossem  Potenzial zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Ebenso erwartet  dich eine hochmoderne

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Fest – und Flüssigphasensynthese, suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Chemie-& Pharmatechnologe im Schichtbetrieb (w/m/d), in Vollzeit.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Führen von Mehrzweckanlagen, 100 - 1000 L Stahl-Emaille-Büchi-Reaktoren (manuell bis PCS7 automatisiert‑7 automatisiert)

Durchführen von Reaktionen mit teilweise hochreaktiven Reagenzien, Destillationen, Extraktionen, und Filtrationen

Ausführen einfacher Laborarbeiten (pH-Messungen, Dünnschichtchromatographie, Trocknungsverlust)

Montage und Demontagearbeiten von Ventilen und Leitungen, sowie kleinere Instandhaltungsarbeiten

Abwechslungsreiche Herstellung von peptidisch und nicht-peptidischen (LPPS) Verbindungen im 20 – 150 kg Massstab unter GMP und non-GMP Bedingungen und Begleitung von Prozesseinführungen aus dem Labormassstab (kein Monobetrieb)

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Chemie- oder Pharmaindustrie, idealerweise in einem GMP- regulierten Umfeld

Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Synthese

Erfahrung in der Bedienung von Mehrzweckreaktoren

Bereitschaft zu körperlicher Arbeit

Bereitschaft zum 3-3-3 Mehrschichtbetrieb (3 Früh-, 3 Spätschichten, 3 Tage frei); Einarbeitung erfolgt in Tagschicht

Kenntnisse in PLS (PCS 7), MES (PAS-X) sind von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

jobs.title: Order Manager CMC (m/w/d), 80-100%
jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Supply Chain suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Order Manager CMC (m/w/d), 80–100%.

Als Order Manager CMC übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der internationalen Auftragsabwicklung. Sie steuern komplexe Material- und Servicebestellungen und verantworten die Export- und Versandprozesse für regulierte Produkte. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Fachbereichen und internationalen Kundinnen und Kunden zusammen.

Wir suchen eine berufserfahrene Persönlichkeit, die anspruchsvolle Aufträge eigenständig steuert, souverän kommuniziert und sich in einem regulierten, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

End ‑ to ‑ End Order Management: Erfassung, Pflege und Steuerung internationaler Kundenaufträge und ‑ projekte in SAP, inklusive Termin- und Prozesskoordination.

Kundenbetreuung international: Proaktive Kommunikation, Klärung von Auftragsdetails, Versand von Bestellbestätigungen und Rechnungen sowie enge Abstimmung bei kundenspezifischen 
• Anforderungen.

Export- & Versandverantwortung: Erstellung, Prüfung und Verwaltung sämtlicher Export-, Versand- und Zolldokumente, sichere Anwendung der Incoterms sowie Einhaltung gesetzlicher und interner Vorgaben.

Koordination von Distributionsprozessen: Steuerung externer Logistik- und Transportpartner (kaufmännisch & prozessseitig, nicht operativ), inklusive Sendungsverfolgung, Eskalationsmanagement und Qualitätsanforderungen.

Regulatorische Compliance: Sicherstellung der vollständigen, korrekten und revisionssicheren Dokumentation gemäss GMP-/GDP-Richtlinien und internen SOPs.

Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung von Order-Management- und Exportprozessen.

Ihr Profil:

Kaufmännische Grundausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung in Export, Aussenhandel oder Supply Chain Management.

Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im internationalen Order Management, Customer Service oder der Auftragsabwicklung – vorzugsweise in einem regulierten Umfeld (z. B. GMP/GDP).

Fundierte Export- und Versandkompetenz, inkl. Erfahrung mit Export- und Zolldokumenten sowie sicherer Anwendung der Incoterms (zwingend).

Routine in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Logistik- und Transportpartnern auf kaufmännischer Ebene.

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Sicherer Umgang mit SAP und MS Office; hohe digitale Affinität.

Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Kundenorientierung und professionelles Auftreten im internationalen Umfeld.

Strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Detailgenauigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit, die auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick behält.

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel dipartimento Supply Chain, stiamo cercando un Order Manager dedicato CMC (m/f/d), 80-100%. In qualità di Order Manager CMC, assumi un ruolo centrale nell'elaborazione degli ordini internazionali. Gestisci ordini di materiali e servizi complessi e sei responsabile dei processi di esportazione e spedizione per i prodotti regolamentati. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i dipartimenti interni e i clienti internazionali.
• Cerchiamo una persona con esperienza professionale in grado di gestire in modo indipendente ordini impegnativi, comunicare con sicurezza e sentirsi a proprio agio in un ambiente regolamentato e dinamico.
• I tuoi compiti: Gestione degli ordini end-to-end: registrazione, mantenimento e controllo degli ordini e dei progetti dei clienti internazionali in SAP, compreso il coordinamento degli appuntamenti e dei processi. Assistenza clienti internazionale: comunicazione proattiva, chiarimento dei dettagli dell'ordine, invio di conferme d'ordine e fatture nonché stretto coordinamento con le esigenze specifiche del cliente. Responsabilità di esportazione e spedizione: creazione, controllo e gestione di tutti i documenti di esportazione, spedizione e dogana, applicazione sicura degli Incoterms e conformità ai requisiti legali e interni. Coordinamento dei processi di distribuzione: controllo dei partner logistici e di trasporto esterni (commerciali e legati ai processi, non operativi), compreso il monitoraggio delle spedizioni, la gestione dell'escalation e i requisiti di qualità. Conformità normativa: garantire una documentazione completa, corretta e a prova di audit in conformità con le linee guida GMP/GDP e le SOP interne. Ottimizzazione dei processi: partecipazione attiva all'ulteriore sviluppo e armonizzazione dei processi di gestione degli ordini e di esportazione. Il tuo profilo: formazione commerciale di base o qualifica comparabile, possibilmente con formazione continua in esportazione, commercio estero o gestione della catena di fornitura. Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione degli ordini internazionali, nel servizio clienti o nell'elaborazione degli ordini, preferibilmente in un ambiente regolamentato (ad esempio GMP/GDP). Solida competenza in materia di esportazioni e spedizioni, inclusa esperienza con documenti di esportazione e doganali, nonché applicazione sicura degli Incoterms (obbligatorio). Routine nel lavorare con partner logistici e di trasporto internazionali a livello commerciale. Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia parlata che scritta. Utilizzo sicuro di SAP e MS Office; elevata affinità digitale. Forti capacità di comunicazione, orientamento al cliente e aspetto professionale in un ambiente internazionale. Metodo di lavoro strutturato, affidabile e indipendente con un elevato livello di attenzione ai dettagli e senso di responsabilità. Personalità orientata al team che mantiene una visione d'insieme anche in situazioni complesse. La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne Orari di lavoro flessibili con la possibilità di lavorare da casa e di prendere giorni di ferie aggiuntivi con un carico di lavoro ridotto Asilo nido interno nel campus Bachem Bubendorf Copertura del 60% dei contributi alla cassa pensione da parte della Bachem AG nonché la possibilità di previdenza sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio opzionale Accesso a piattaforme vantaggio con sconti di partner esterni Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante per i dipendenti Molteplici opzioni gratuite Attività sportive nel campus Bachem Desiderate guidare l’innovazione insieme a noi? <span st
descriptionByLocale.en:
To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. We are looking for a dedicated/n order manager CMC (m/w/d), 80–100% to strengthen our team in the Supply Chain department. As order manager CMC, you play a central role in international order processing. They control complex material and service orders and are responsible for export and shipping processes for regulated products. You work closely with internal departments and international customers. We are looking for a professionally experienced person who controls demanding orders independently, communicates and feels comfortable in a regulated, dynamic environment. Your tasks: End ‐ to ‐ End Order Management: Collection, maintenance and control of international customer orders and projects in SAP, including appointment and process coordination. Customer support international: Proactive communication, clarification of order details, delivery of order confirmations and invoices as well as close coordination with customer-specific
• Requirements. Export & Shipping Responsibility: creation, testing and administration of all export, shipping and customs documents, safe application of the Incoterms and compliance with legal and internal requirements. Coordination of distribution processes: control of external logistics and transport partners (commercial & process-related, non-operational), including tracking of shipments, escalation management and quality requirements. Regulatory compliance: Ensuring complete, correct and audit-proof documentation according to GMP/GDP guidelines and internal SOPs. Process optimization: Active cooperation in the further development and harmonisation of order management and export processes. Your profile: Basic commercial training or comparable qualification, ideally with further training in export, foreign trade or supply chain management. At least 5 years of experience in international order management, customer service or order processing – preferably in a regulated environment (e.g. GMP/GDP). Found export and shipping expertise, including experience with export and customs documents as well as safe use of the Incoterms (forced). Routine in cooperation with international logistics and transport partners at the commercial level. Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing. Secure handling of SAP and MS Office; high digital affinity. Embossed communication strength, customer orientation and professional appearance in the international environment. Structured, reliable and independent operation with high detail accuracy and responsibility awareness. Team-oriented personality, which also keeps an overview in complex situations. jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Chromatographie suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Chemie-& Pharmatechnologe im Schichtbetrieb (w/m/d), in Vollzeit .

Ihre Aufgaben:

Durchführung chemischer Prozessschritte im Produktionsumfeld (z. B. Zyklisierung, Decarboxylierung, Faltung, Destillation) gemäss Herstellvorschriften

Herstellung und Handling von Puffern, Lösungen, Lösungsmitteln, Wirkstoffen und Suspensionen inkl. Vorlegen/Einziehen von Prozesslösungen gemäss HVO

Filtration von Prozess- und Produktlösungen sowie Packen/Entpacken von Chromatographiesäulen inkl. Vorbereitung von Säulen-Suspensionen

Prozesskontrolle inkl. Scannen, Wiegen, Kalibrieren von pH-Messgeräten, pH-Einstellung, Probenzug und Anmeldung zur Analytik

Bedienung von Automationssystemen (SIMATIC PCS7 / PAX X, WinCC, SIMATIC Batch) sowie grundlegendes Verständnis von Verdränger- und Kreiselpumpen

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/-login EFZ (oder vergleichbar) oder mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Produktionsumfeld

Fundiertes Verständnis für Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bereitschaft zum Mehrschichtmodell: 3-3-3 (3 Früh-3 Spät- 3 Frei) sowie  6-4 Schichtbetrieb (6 Tage Arbeit – 4 Tage frei)

Idealerweise Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie im Umgang mit Produktionsanlagen und Reaktoren

Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in HPLC, Ultrafiltration (UF/DF) oder elektronischen Batch Records (z. B. PAS-X)

Interesse an kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement, 5S) und an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

descriptionByLocale.en:

• Your tasks: Checking the GMP manufacturing documentation for the release of our active ingredients Checking the documentation of intermediate and final stages for GMP conformity and compliance with internal regulations Discussing any anomalies with the executors in the producing areas and agreeing on the necessary corrective measures Regular presence in production on site as "QA Person in Plant" for, among other things, carrying out sample checks of GMP manufacturing documentation in progress Determining the authorization of customers to purchase our active ingredients, checking shipping documentation for our GMP products Implementing the GDP (Good Distribution Practice) guidelines in the area of the provision, handling and distribution of our GMP products
• Your profile: Apprenticeship as a chemical laboratory technician, chemical-technical assistant (CTA), chemical and pharmaceutical technologist or comparable training At least 2 years of professional experience within the chemical/pharmaceutical industry, preferably in a GMP environment. in the control of GMP manufacturing documentation You are used to creating, checking documents and implementing corrective measures. jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Engineering Services suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n CAD / CAE System Spezialisten (w/m/d), 80 – 100%.

In dieser Funktion sind Sie für die Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs und der Weiterentwicklung unserer AVEVA-Autorentools als Key User und Administrator zuständig, sowie für die Planerstellung im Rahmen von Projekten zum Um- bzw. Neubau von Produktions- oder Infrastrukturanlagen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

AVEVA Super-User / Administration

Betreuung und Administration der AVEVA-Autorentools (z. B. E3D, Unified Engineering oder vergleichbare Lösungen)

First- und Second-Level-Support für Anwender

Einrichtung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Templates, Standards und Datenbanken

Durchführung von Schulungen und Unterstützung neuer Anwender

Schnittstellenmanagement zu IT, Engineering und externen Partnern

CAD / CAE

3D Aufstellungs- und Rohrleitungsplanung für komplexe Chemie- und Pharmaanlagen.

Erstellung weiterer Designdokumente, wie z.B. R&I-Schemata, Isometrien, Stücklisten und Halterungszeichnungen

die räumliche Koordination aller Gewerke, wie z.B. Gebäude, Elektro, EMSR, Lüftung und Reinraum.

Begleitung der Anlagenrealisierung

Support bei der Implementierung von BIM

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung z. B. als Konstrukteur/in der Anlagen- oder Gebäudeplanung oder vergleichbar

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Anlagenplanung, Verfahrens- und/ oder Gebäudetechnik (bevorzugt im chemisch- / pharmazeutischen Umfeld)

Fundierte Kenntnisse in AVEVA CAD/CAE-Tools, Erfahrung in der Rolle als Key User, CAD-Administrator oder Super-User von Vorteil

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der CAD-Konstruktion (2D/3D)

Hohe Belastbarkeit und ein Faible für die digitale Planung

Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100%
jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100%.

The Global IT/OT Network Architect defines and governs the company’s global network architecture across enterprise IT and operational technology environments, directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts).

The role combines full ownership and design authority of enterprise & industrial/OT network architecture, and site-level solution architecture for offices, production environments, warehouses, and laboratories, including a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap.

The role ensures that IT and OT networks are secure, resilient, scalable, standardized, maintainable, and aligned with business, operational, cybersecurity, and GxP compliance requirements.

Your tasks :

Define and maintain global network architecture standards for enterprise, industrial, cloud, and site environments across global sites. Assume full ownership and design authority for global network architecture.

Support Bachem’s digital strategy, in particular digital manufacturing and Pharma 4.0 concepts, and provide technical governance for managed service providers, telecom carriers, automation vendors, and OT system integrators.

Own a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap, including modernization, standardization, technical debt reduction, and end-of-life planning.

Design secure and resilient OT network architectures for shop-floor and production environments, including IT/OT segmentation using zones, conduits, DMZs, firewalls, VLANs, access controls, and controlled data flows.

Ensure local network designs align with global standards and site-specific operational needs by supporting design reviews, commissioning, cutovers, migrations, acceptance testing, and post-implementation validation.

Ensure network architecture supports cybersecurity, risk, and GxP compliance requirements across IT and OT by aligning with internal policies and relevant standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST OT security guidance, and ITIL practices.

Maintain architecture documentation, including standards, reference architectures, site blueprints, segmentation models, design templates, decision records, exceptions, and risk acceptance documentation.

Ensure designs are operationally supportable by IT, OT, site, and managed service teams, and define operational runbooks, support models, escalation paths, and disaster recovery requirements.

Your profile:

Extensive experience in network architecture, infrastructure architecture, or senior network engineering in global or multi-site enterprise environments, ensuring GxP compliance.

Practical experience with OT or industrial networks designing IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity patterns in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, or similar environments.

Per aumentare la nostra squadra nel dipartimento IT globale, stiamo cercando un Global IT/OT Network Architect dedicato (f/m/d), 100%. Il Global IT/OT Network Architect definisce e governa l'architettura di rete globale dell'azienda in ambienti IT aziendali e tecnologie operative, supportando direttamente la strategia digitale di Bachem (manifattura digitale, concetti Pharma 4.0). Il ruolo combina la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione dell'architettura di rete aziendale e industriale/OT, nonché l'architettura delle soluzioni a livello di sito per uffici, ambienti di produzione, laboratori, inclusa una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine. Il ruolo garantito che le reti IT e OT siano sicure, resilienti, scalabili, standardizzate, manutenibili e allineate ai requisiti aziendali, operative, di sicurezza informatica e di conformità GxP. Compiti - Definire e mantenere gli standard di architettura di rete globale per gli ambienti aziendali, industriali, cloud e sito in tutto il mondo. Assumi la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione per l'architettura di rete globale. - Supportare la strategia digitale di Bachem, in particolare la manifattura digitale e i concetti Pharma 4.0, e fornire la governance tecnica per i fornitori di servizi organizzati, le compagnie telefoniche, i fornitori di automazione e gli integratori di sistemi OT. - Possedere una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine, inclusi la modernizzazione, la standardizzazione, la riduzione del debito tecnico e la pianificazione della fine del ciclo di vita. - Progettare architetture di rete OT sicuro e resilienti per gli ambienti di produzione a piano terra, inclusa la segmentazione IT/OT local Zone, condottier, DMZ, firewall, VLAN, controlli di accesso e flussi di dati controllati. - Garantire che i progetti di rete locali siano allineati con gli standard globali e le esigenze operative site-specific attraverso il supporto alle revisioni di progettazione, alla messa in servizio, ai passaggi, alle migrazioni, ai test di accettazione e alla validazione post-implementazione. - Garantire che l'architettura della rete supporti i requisiti di sicurezza informatica, il rischio e la conformità GxP in tutto l'IT e l'OT allineandosi con le politiche interna e gli standard definiti come IEC 62443, ISO 27001, le linee guida sulla sicurezza OT di NIST e le pratiche ITIL. - Mantenere la documentazione dell'architettura, inclusi gli standard, le architetture di riferimento, i piani delle site, i modelli di segmentazione, i template di progettazione, i registri delle decisioni, le teorie e la documentazione di accettazione del rischio. - Garantire che le progettazioni siano supportate operativemente dagli team IT, OT, site e dei servizi idonei, e definire i manuali operativi, i modelli di supporto, i percorsi di escalation e i requisiti di recupero di emergenza. Profilo - Esperienza estesa in architettura di rete, architettura dell'obiettivo o ingegneria di rete senior in ambienti aziendali globali o multi-sito, garantendo la conformità GxP. - Esperienza pratica con le reti OT o industriale progettando la segmentazione IT/OT e i modelli di connessione sicura nella manifattura, nella farmaceutica o in ambienti simili. jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Peptide Manufacturing II suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Chemist (w/m/d), 100% .

Synthese von Wirkstoffen und deren Zwischenstufen basierend auf Flüssigphasen- oder Festphasensynthese-Technologien von Peptiden

Fachliche und projektbezogene Führungskompetenz

Praktische, konzeptionelle und analytische Arbeitsweise

Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit sowie kommunikative Fähigkeiten

Zuverlässigkeit, hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und exakte Arbeitsweise

Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

jobs.title: Group Leader Dispensing 100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Dispensation suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Group Leader Dispensing (w/m/d) 100% im Schichtbetrieb (Frühschicht/Spätschicht)

Sie wollen nicht nur verwalten, sondern Prozesse gestalten, Innovationen vorantreiben und mit Ihrem Team echte Veränderung bewirken? Bei Bachem erhalten Sie die Plattform, um Ihre Führungsqualität und Ideen voll einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie führen und entwickeln ein engagiertes Schichtteam (5-10 Mitarbeitende) im Bereich Dispensing und sind selbst mitten im Geschehen

Sie verantworten die GMP-konforme, termingerechte manuelle Portionierung von Rohstoffen, Zwischenprodukten und APIs für interne und externe Kunden

Sie steuern alle Abläufe in Ihrer Organisationseinheit und stellen sicher, dass Qualität, Menge und Timing jederzeit stimmen

Sie treiben Wachstum und Veränderungen aktiv voran: Mit neuen Ideen, Prozessoptimierungen und dem Mut, Bestehendes zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln

Sie bauen starke Schnittstellen zu anderen Produktionsbereichen auf und bringen Ihr Team sowie die Organisation spürbar voran

Sie setzen Standards in Arbeitssicherheit, Umweltschutz und Compliance

Sie fördern neue Mitarbeitende und stärken den Teamspirit durch gezielte Schulung und Entwicklung

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Chemielaborant oder im Bereich Logistik (z.B. Logistiker EFZ), ergänzt durch Weiterbildung (z.B. HFP, Fachausweis)

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im GMP-regulierten Bereich der manuellen Dispensing / Portionierung

Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung und die Motivation, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dein Team aktiv weiterzuentwickeln

Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und Freude an Teamarbeit

Erfahrung im Umgang mit Chemikalien, Wirkstoffen, Reinraumtechnik und geschlossenen Anlagen (Containment)

Analytisches Denken und betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis

Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP und/oder MES-Systemen

Sehr gutes Deutsch, Grundkenntnisse Englisch

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten</spa

descriptionByLocale.it: Per far progredire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team nella dispensazione, siamo alla ricerca di una Dispensing Leader dedicata/n (w/m/d) 100% nel funzionamento a turni (strato di spruzzo/strato di molla) Non solo vuoi gestire, vuoi progettare processi, guidare l'innovazione e fare un cambiamento reale con il tuo team? A Bachem si otterrà la piattaforma per integrare pienamente la vostra qualità di leadership e idee e crescere insieme a noi. I vostri compiti: Guidano e sviluppano un team di turni dedicato (5-10 dipendenti) nell'area di erogazione e si trovano al centro dell'azione Sei responsabile per la porzionatura manuale tempestiva e conforme a GMP di materie prime, intermedi e API per clienti interni ed esterni Si controlla tutti i processi nella vostra unità organizzativa e assicurarsi che la qualità, la quantità e la tempistica siano corrette in qualsiasi momento Promuovano attivamente la crescita e il cambiamento: con nuove idee, ottimizzazione dei processi e il coraggio di mettere in discussione e di sviluppare esistenti Costruisci interfacce forti ad altre aree di produzione e rendi il tuo team e il progresso tangibile dell'organizzazione Esse fissano le norme in materia di sicurezza del lavoro, protezione dell'ambiente e conformità Promuovano nuovi dipendenti e rafforzano lo spirito del team attraverso la formazione mirata e lo sviluppo Il tuo profilo: Formazione completa come laboratorio chimico, chimico o nel campo della logistica (ad esempio logistica EFZ), integrata da un'ulteriore formazione (ad esempio HFP, ID specialistico) Esperienza professionale pluriennale nell'area regolamentata GMP di erogazione manuale / porzionatura Rilevabile esperienza di leadership e motivazione per assumersi la responsabilità e sviluppare attivamente il vostro team mentalità, iniziativa e gioia nel lavoro di squadra Esperienza nella gestione di prodotti chimici, principi attivi, tecnologia ambiente pulito e sistemi chiusi (Containment) Il pensiero analitico e la comprensione economica Conoscenza dei sistemi SAP e/o MES Molto buono tedesco, conoscenza di base inglese La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con ulteriore sviluppo interno e ulteriori opportunità di formazione </spa
descriptionByLocale.en:
To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. In order to strengthen our team in the dispensation, we are looking for a dedicated/n Group Leader Dispensing (w/m/d) 100% in shift operation (spring layer/spring layer) You don't just want to manage, you want to design processes, drive innovation and make a real change with your team? At Bachem you will get the platform to fully integrate your leadership quality and ideas and grow together with us.
• Your tasks: They lead and develop a dedicated shift team (5-10 employees) in the area of dispensing and are themselves in the middle of action You are responsible for the GMP-compliant, timely manual portioning of raw materials, intermediates and APIs for internal and external customers You control all processes in your organization unit and make sure that quality, quantity and timing are correct at any time They actively promote growth and change: with new ideas, process optimization and the courage to question and develop existing You build strong interfaces to other production areas and make your team and the organization tangible progress They set standards in occupational safety, environmental protection and compliance They promote new employees and strengthen the team spirit through targeted training and development
• Your profile: Complete training as a chemical, chemical laboratory or in the field of logistics (e.g. logistics EFZ), supplemented by further education (e.g. HFP, specialist ID) Multiannual professional experience in the GMP-regulated area of manual dispensing / portioning Detectable leadership experience and motivation to take responsibility and develop your team actively Hands-on mentality, initiative and joy in team work Experience in handling chemicals, active ingredients, clean room technology and closed systems (Containment) Analytical thinking and economic understanding Knowledge in SAP and/or MES systems Very good German, basic knowledge English Our offer: A dynamic and growing working environment with internal further development and further training opportunities </spa

jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides. With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

As  Automation Engineer  /  Project Engineer  for the  Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) , you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

Your Tasks:

Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups

Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments

Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios

Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components

Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments

Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab

Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting

Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation

Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable

Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

Your 
• Profile:

University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups

Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

Potrai combinare competenze nell'automazione dei processi, nella simulazione e nell'infrastruttura di laboratorio per consentire a ingegneri, scienziati di dati e sviluppatori di progettare, testare e implementare soluzioni innovative. jobs.title: QA Shopfloor Manager 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
To advance our vision of a shopfloor-integrated QA function, we are seeking a  QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d)  who brings both expertise and a collaborative mindset to our dynamic and motivated team. The ideal candidate will not only complement our existing capabilities but also contribute fresh perspectives and drive continuous improvement in our operational quality practices.

Your tasks:

Provide proactive quality presence on the shopfloor to ensure uninterrupted, compliant manufacturing operations and meeting adherence to schedule

Act as the primary QA point of contact for production teams enabling fast, informed decision-making and real-time issue resolution

Ensure seamless QA support by coordinating across QA functions to deliver consistent, and efficient quality support to manufacturing and support preparing quality rated answers for customer requests

Enforce strict adherence to internal procedures and GxP requirements supporting right-first-time execution and minimizing delays

Support investigations into deviations and non-conformances, ensuring robust root cause analysis, effective CAPA implementation, and timely closure

Accelerate by facilitating rapid assessments and ensuring high-quality documentation of quality-related matters

Represent QA in daily and weekly shop floor meetings, addressing quality risks and promoting a solutions-oriented mindset

Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency

Foster a culture of ownership and accountability on the shopfloor , where quality, accountability, and continuous improvement is seen as an enabler

Your profile:

University degree (Bachelor/Master) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Natural Sciences, or a comparable scientific or technical discipline, with relevant experience in the field

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in API manufacturing, preferably within a CDMO environment

Demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, with direct exposure to manufacturing operations

Strong working knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, and ALCOA+ principles

High level of interest in manufacturing processes and operational QA topics, with a mindset geared toward best practices and modern technologies

Familiarity with quality systems and documentation processes, including deviation handling, CAPA, and change control

Experience with or willingness to develop skills in Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies

Proficient in both written and spoken German and English

Our offer:

A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

The ideal candidate will not only complement our existing capabilities but also contribute fresh perspectives and drive continuous improvement in our operational quality practices. ## Mansioni - Provide proactive quality presence on the shopfloor to ensure uninterrupted, compliant manufacturing operations and meeting adherence to schedule - Act as the primary QA point of contact for production teams enabling fast, informed decision-making and real-time issue resolution - Ensure seamless QA support by coordinating across QA functions to deliver consistent, and efficient quality support to manufacturing and support preparing quality rated answers for customer requests - Enforce strict adherence to internal procedures and GxP requirements supporting right-first-time execution and minimizing delays - Support investigations into deviations and non-conformances, ensuring robust root cause analysis, effective CAPA implementation, and timely closure - Accelerate by facilitating rapid assessments and ensuring high-quality documentation of quality-related matters - Represent QA in daily and weekly shop floor meetings, addressing quality risks and promoting a solutions-oriented mindset - Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency - Foster a culture of ownership and accountability on the shopfloor , where quality, accountability, and continuous improvement is seen as an enabler ##
• Requisiti - University degree (Bachelor/Master) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Natural Sciences, or a comparable scientific or technical discipline, with relevant experience in the field - Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in API manufacturing, preferably within a CDMO environment - Demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, with direct exposure to manufacturing operations - Strong working knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, and ALCOA+ principles - High level of interest in manufacturing processes and operational QA topics, with a mindset geared toward best practices and modern technologies - Familiarity with quality systems and documentation processes, including deviation handling, CAPA, and change control - Experience with or willingness to develop skills in Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies - Proficient in both written and spoken German and English ##
• Cosa offriamo - A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities - Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction - Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities - 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus - Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners - Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant - A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus ## Contatto Would you like to drive innovation together with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf! Hinweis: Bewerbungen von Personalagenturen werden nicht berücksichtigt. Descrizione Pour faire progresser notre vision d'une fonction d'AQ intégrée à l'atelier, nous recherchons un gestionnaire d'AQ (f/m/d) qui apporte à la fois son expertise et un esprit de collaboration à notre équipe dynamique et motivée. Le candidat idéal complétera non seulement nos capacités existantes, mais il apportera également de nouvelles perspectives et favorisera l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques de qualité opérationnelle. Mansioni - Assurer une présence de qualité proactive sur l'atelier pour assurer des opérations de fabrication ininterrompues et conformes et respecter le calendrier - Agir en tant que principal point de contact de l'AQ pour les équipes de production permettant de prendre des décisions rapides et éclairées et de résoudre les problèmes en temps réel - Assurer un soutien sans faille de l'AQ en coordonnant toutes les fonctions de l'AQ pour fournir un soutien de qualité cohérent et efficace à la fabrication et pour préparer des réponses cotées de qualité aux demandes des clients - Appliquer le strict respect des procédures internes et des exigences du GxP en faveur de l ' exécution en premier et minimisant les retards - Appuyer les enquêtes sur les écarts et les non-conformités, en assurant une analyse robuste des causes profondes, une mise en oeuvre efficace de l'ACAP et une fermeture rapide - Accélérer en facilitant les évaluations rapides et en assurant la qualité de la documentation sur les questions liées à la qualité - Représenter l'assurance qualité dans les réunions quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, aborder les risques de qualité et promouvoir un état d'esprit axé sur les solutions - Diriger et contribuer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui améliorent la qualité, réduisent les déchets et améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle - Favoriser une culture de l'appropriation et de la responsabilisation dans l'atelier, où la qualité, la responsabilisation et l'amélioration continue sont considérées comme un catalyseur
• Requisiti - Diplôme universitaire (Bachelor/Master) en chimie, chimie organique, sciences naturelles ou une discipline scientifique ou technique comparable, avec une expérience pertinente dans le domaine - minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la fabrication d'API, de préférence dans un environnement CDMO - Expertise démontrée en assurance de la qualité, avec une exposition directe aux opérations de fabrication - Forte connaissance pratique des BPF, des exigences réglementaires et des principes ALCOA+ - Intérêt élevé pour les procédés de fabrication et les sujets opérationnels d'AQ, avec un état d'esprit orienté vers les meilleures pratiques et les technologies modernes - Familiarisation avec les systèmes de qualité et les processus de documentation, y compris la manipulation des écarts, l'ACP et le contrôle des changements - Expérience ou volonté de développer des compétences dans Lean, Six Sigma, ou d'autres méthodologies d'amélioration continue - Compétence en allemand et anglais écrits et parlés
• Cosa offriamo - Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne - Des horaires de travail flexibles avec les jours de bureau à domicile et une option pour obtenir des jours de vacances supplémentaires grâce à la réduction de la charge de travail - Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes - 60 % de la couverture des cotisations des caisses de retraite par Bachem AG, ainsi que l'option pour une pension extra-obligatoire avec notre Régime de retraite Plus - Accès à la plate-forme d'avantages Swibeco avec des rabais de partenaires externes - Des aliments frais, sains et variés dans notre restaurant du personnel - Une large gamme d'activités sportives gratuites sur le campus de Bachem Contatto Aimeriez-vous stimuler l'innovation avec nous ? jobs.description:
Für unser MES-Team in der Abteilung Digital Manufacturing suchen wir eine/n MES Specialist zur Unterstützung bei der Implementierung des Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in neue und bestehende Produktionsprozesse.

Ihre Aufgaben

Aufnahme, Analyse und Umsetzung von Produktions- und Supportprozessen im GMP-Umfeld im Manufacturing Execution System (MES)

Erstellung, Design und Review von Master Batch Records (MBR) sowie Reinigungsvorschriften (ESP)

Analyse von Projektanforderungen sowie Unterstützung im Change- und Anforderungsmanagement

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Materialwirtschaft, Qualitätssicherung und weiteren Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Organisation und Moderation von Projektmeetings und Workshops

Sicherstellung der Systemkommunikation und Schnittstellenintegration zwischen MES und weiteren elektronischen Systemen

Incident-, Problem- und Änderungsmanagement inklusive 2nd-Level-Support und gelegentlichem Pikett-Support

Verwaltung von Benutzerrechten sowie Schulung und Betreuung der MES-Endanwender

Ihr Profil

Ausbildung in IT, Automation, Chemie, Biologie oder Pharmazie mit ausgeprägter Affinität zu IT-Systemen

Erfahrung im Design von Master Batch Records (MBR), idealerweise mit PAS-X

Berufserfahrung in der chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Industrie von Vorteil

Gute Kenntnisse im GMP-Umfeld

Verständnis für Prozessautomation, Verfahrenstechnik, IT-Netzwerke, Datenbanken und/oder Programmiersprachen von Vorteil

Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise

Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

jobs.title: Storage Technician / Logistiker/in EFZ Inbound (w/m/d), 100%
jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Materials Management suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Storage Technician / Logistiker/in EFZ Inbound (w/m/d), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Waren SOP-konform entgegennehmen, kontrollieren und im SAP buchen

Termingerechte Kommissionierung von Kundenbestellungen im Hochregallager, tiefgekühlten, gekühlten und ungekühlten Lagerbereichen

Allgemeine Lagerarbeiten, wie fachgerechtes Ein- und Auslagern der Waren im Hochregallager, tiefgekühlten, gekühlten und ungekühlten Lager

GMP konforme Protokollierung der Tätigkeiten auf Dokumenten

Verpacken, markieren und beschriften von Gefahrgutsendungen gem. Vorgabe ADR/SDR

Korrektes verantwortungsvolles Führen und Bedienen aller zur Verfügung gestellten Hilfsmittel

Durchführung der wöchentlichen und monatlichen Sicherheits-, Wartung- und Kontrollaufgaben

Ihr Profil:

Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Logistiker/in EFZ idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zur Logistikfachfrau / zum Logistikfachmann

3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung in der Logistik

Branchenkenntnisse im Chemie- und Pharmaumfeld

Umgang mit Gefahrengut

Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Hochregallager (WMS)

Versierter Umgang mit SAP S/4 HANA

Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse

Unser Angebot:

Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus
